description: FutureBots es el club STEAM del Colegio Semioficial Quisqueya, un espacio donde la creatividad, la tecnología y la innovación se unen para construir el futuro. A través de la ciencia, la robótica, la ingeniería, el arte y las matemáticas, nuestros estudiantes desarrollan habilidades, resuelven problemas y transforman ideas en proyectos. ¡Aprendemos, creamos y exploramos juntos, porque el futuro comienza con nosotros!
summary:
FutureBots has developed ARES NAV, a web-site platform that simulates a planetary navigation system designed for exploring the surface of Mars. It integrates multiple interactive tools intended to help astronauts face the challenges of planetary exploration and adapt to different situations.

ARES NAV addresses the proposed challenge through an interactive storyline that guides users through the platform's various features. By combining technology, exploration, and storytelling, the project aims to make space exploration more engaging and accessible, particularly for younger generations.

The importance of this initiative lies in its educational purpose: encouraging young people to develop an interest in space exploration and better understand the technologies used in planetary navigation. ARES NAV provides an accessible and interactive way to experience how a navigation system might support astronauts during missions on Mars, while inspiring curiosity about the future of human space exploration.
details:
Ares_Nav is a space navigation system simulator that astronauts can use as an environment for navigation and organization, through the integration of other devices.

It includes an interactive story that helps young people understand how space navigation works and sparks their interest in science. It also features voice chat for interacting with the system.

Technologies

  • HTML, CSS, and JavaScript written by hand, with no external libraries or frameworks.
  • Python with Pillow, as a support tool during development.
  • Google Chrome, GitHub, and GitHub Pages for testing, version control, and publishing.
  • SVG for the rover and drone illustrations.

Use of Artificial Intelligence

The rover and drone illustrations were generated with AI and carry the “ia-generate” mark. Claude Opus 5.5 was used during development, contributing to part of the code, to searching for and verifying sources, and to designing both illustrations.
